_comment: Engine third-party dependency manifest. Only engine-direct dependencies are listed. Vulkan SDK / volk / VulkanMemoryAllocator / glfw3 / fmt are intentionally NOT listed because they are pulled in transitively (Vulkan stack via OrangeRender's find_dependency, fmt via spdlog's bundled copy) and the engine itself does not consume their headers directly outside of the dedicated isolated source trees that already document each rule.

dependencies.name: spdlog
dependencies.purpose: Logging backend for Core::Log. Public headers do NOT include spdlog — the gate only switches the implementation in src/core/Log.cpp.

dependencies.name: glm
dependencies.purpose: Math types (Vec2/3/4, Mat3/4, Quat) appearing in public engine API

dependencies.name: EnTT
dependencies.purpose: ECS registry. Component types appear in public engine API because the game registers its own components.

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.purpose: JSON backend for Core::Serialization::JsonReader / JsonWriter. Public API does not expose nlohmann::json types — see越界禁令 in docs/extension-points.md.

dependencies.name: Box2D
dependencies.purpose: 2D physics backend. Allowed only in src/physics/box2d/.

dependencies.name: miniaudio
dependencies.purpose: Cross-platform audio backend. Allowed only in src/audio/miniaudio/.

dependencies.name: stb
dependencies.purpose: stb_image (texture decode), stb_truetype (font rasterization). Single-header inclusion.

dependencies.name: Dear ImGui
dependencies.purpose: Immediate-mode GUI for editor / debug overlays. Phase 6 feature; integrated via GLFW + Vulkan backends.

dependencies.name: DragonBonesCPP
dependencies.purpose: 2D skeletal animation runtime. Allowed only in src/animation/dragonbones/. C++ runtime maintenance is a known risk; abstraction layer in include/orange/engine/animation/IAnimator.h preserves the option to swap backends.
